business_rule_review.introductory_source_text:
Agencia Tributaria                                           Facturación Electrónica

1  INTRODUCCIÓN


A continuación, se recogen las reglas de negocio aplicables a cada uno de los mensajes de alta
previstos en el Anexo II de la Orden Ministerial HAC/1028/2026, de 2 de octubre.


No se incluyen como reglas de negocio:

     -  Supuestos en los que el contenido de un campo viene prefijado o restringido por el mapeo del
      Anexo I.
     -  Supuestos en los que el contenido de un campo viene prefijado por el uso de códigos previstos
      de una lista.
     -   Validaciones relativas al número de identificación fiscal.
     -   Reglas de negocio que derivan del esquema “application response” de UBL 2.5.


La factura que se informa debe constar en la Solución Pública de Facturación Electrónica, en caso
contrario se rechazará el mensaje.

Los mensajes de anulación deben contener la totalidad de los datos identificativos de la factura
informada, y esta factura debe existir en la Solución Pública de Facturación Electrónica, y no debe
haber sido anulada, en caso contrario se rechazará el mensaje.


2  REGLAS DE NEGOCIO

2.1 REGLAS DE NEGOCIO GENERALES


En este apartado se especifican las reglas de negocio aplicables a todos los mensajes previstos en el
Anexo II.

non_field_requirements.meaning: The invoice must be present in SPFE; otherwise the message is rejected.
Cancellation messages retain all invoice identity data; the invoice must exist in SPFE and must not have been cancelled.

validation_context_not_new_API_fields: Saved seller and buyer identity; buyer identity is needed for recipient reports even though seller identity appears in the four wire reference fields.
Saved invoice type and the exact referenced invoice revision; do not infer them from positive/negative amounts or the caller.
Saved BT-113 and BT-115 facts kept distinct until the disputed negative-amount operand is confirmed.
Qualified invoice-presence/cancellation evidence, report history, actor/service and prior attempt outcomes. No new lookup endpoint is established.
Actual SPFE dispatch business date and qualified comparison calendar/timezone; original event dates remain unchanged during recovery.

open_decisions.source: BR-PAGO-8 / BR-COBRO-5 / BR-IMPAGO-5; final Annex I BT-113/115; S31 lines 141/143
open_decisions.decision: Confirm intended amount and interaction with final PAYMENT NegativeAmountInvoice. Hold affected report eligibility; do not invent a report amount or globally reject negative invoices.

open_decisions.source: BR-RECHAZO-3 p. 5 versus S28 ACTION-09 variants at lines 310/312
open_decisions.decision: Confirm strictly-after versus on-or-after issue-date boundary. Preserve exact observed wording; do not choose the permissive or restrictive interpretation as a silent default.

Qualify source indicator meaning, type conditions and XML presence/value representation. A proposed boolean false is not established as absence. Keep corrected versus corrective/negative meanings separate.

open_decisions.source: BR-ANEXOII-1/2/3 and cancellation prose p. 3; event date upper bounds pp. 4–6
open_decisions.decision: Qualify invoice evidence freshness, duplicate/compatibility scope, sender clock/calendar and original-outcome recovery. The draft supplies no replay guarantee, full transition matrix or new query contract.

limits: All 28 raw rule rows and their exact source locators are retained. Numbered rules complement the 52 final-source field rows; no original field IDs, action codes or UUIDs are replaced.
Section 1 excludes fixed mapping values, code-list, NIF and UBL ApplicationResponse schema checks. Those layers remain independently required for the selected profile.
Raw source uses Annex I in an exclusion statement in this Annex II document; preserve that wording rather than silently repairing it.

General rules apply to all Annex II messages; event-specific rules are attached only to the four named report families. Cancellation does not inherit payment dates or indicators merely because its name includes PAYMENT.
Context values are logical evidence requirements, not newly defined API fields or XML elements. Existing open statusAttributes schema does not prove validation or Spain runtime support.
No resource key is assigned as a wire code by matching rule numbers. SPEC011 owns response/error interpretation and recovery.
The source is version 0.1 Borrador. Final BOE remains legal authority; conflicts, accepted schema profile and implementation coverage remain open.
